apps.name: ParkBud
apps.subtitle: Street-cleaning parking reminders for your block
apps.localizedDescription:
ParkBud looks up your street-cleaning schedule from an address and tells you which side of the street to park on. Add the Lock Screen widget for a live reminder of current restrictions.

SideStore will re-sign this IPA with your Apple ID before install. Refresh the app about every 7 days if you use a free developer account. The widget and App Group extras may not survive every signing setup; the iPhone app is the install target.

permissions.usageDescription: ParkBud uses your location when you park to work out which side of the street your car is on and when that side is swept.
